
---
title: "Project Overview Classification Methods in Statistical Learning"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(MASS)
library(caTools)
library(ggplot2)
library(e1071)
library(class)
library(dplyr)
```

## 1. Load and Prepare the Auto Dataset

```{r load-data}
auto_data <- read.table("Auto.data", header=TRUE, na.strings="?")
auto_data <- na.omit(auto_data)
auto_data$name <- NULL
auto_data$mpg01 <- ifelse(auto_data$mpg > median(auto_data$mpg), 1, 0)
head(auto_data)
```

## 2. Exploratory Data Analysis

### Identify Useful Predictors

```{r boxplots}
ggplot(auto_data, aes(x=factor(mpg01), y=displacement)) + geom_boxplot() + theme_minimal()
ggplot(auto_data, aes(x=factor(mpg01), y=horsepower)) + geom_boxplot() + theme_minimal()
ggplot(auto_data, aes(x=factor(mpg01), y=weight)) + geom_boxplot() + theme_minimal()
ggplot(auto_data, aes(x=factor(mpg01), y=year)) + geom_boxplot() + theme_minimal()
```

## 3. Data Splitting

```{r data-split}
set.seed(42)
split <- sample.split(auto_data$mpg01, SplitRatio = 0.7)
train_data <- subset(auto_data, split == TRUE)
test_data <- subset(auto_data, split == FALSE)
cat("Training Size:", nrow(train_data), "\n")
cat("Testing Size:", nrow(test_data), "\n")
```

## 4. Linear Discriminant Analysis (LDA)

```{r lda}
lda_model <- lda(mpg01 ~ displacement + horsepower + weight + year, data = train_data)
lda_preds <- predict(lda_model, test_data)$class
lda_error <- mean(lda_preds != test_data$mpg01)
cat("LDA Test Error:", lda_error, "\n")
```

## 5. Quadratic Discriminant Analysis (QDA)

```{r qda}
qda_model <- qda(mpg01 ~ displacement + horsepower + weight + year, data = train_data)
qda_preds <- predict(qda_model, test_data)$class
qda_error <- mean(qda_preds != test_data$mpg01)
cat("QDA Test Error:", qda_error, "\n")
```

## 6. Logistic Regression

```{r logistic}
log_reg_model <- glm(mpg01 ~ displacement + horsepower + weight + year,
                     data = train_data, family = binomial)
log_reg_probs <- predict(log_reg_model, test_data, type = "response")
log_reg_preds <- ifelse(log_reg_probs > 0.5, 1, 0)
log_reg_error <- mean(log_reg_preds != test_data$mpg01)
cat("Logistic Regression Test Error:", log_reg_error, "\n")
```

## 7. Naive Bayes

```{r naive-bayes}
nb_model <- naiveBayes(mpg01 ~ displacement + horsepower + weight + year,
                       data = train_data)
nb_preds <- predict(nb_model, test_data)
nb_error <- mean(nb_preds != test_data$mpg01)
cat("Naive Bayes Test Error:", nb_error, "\n")
```

## 8. K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN)

```{r knn}
train_knn <- scale(train_data[, c('displacement', 'horsepower', 'weight', 'year')])
test_knn <- scale(test_data[, c('displacement', 'horsepower', 'weight', 'year')])
train_labels <- train_data$mpg01
test_labels <- test_data$mpg01
knn_errors <- c()
for (k in 1:20) {
  knn_preds <- knn(train_knn, test_knn, train_labels, k = k)
  knn_errors[k] <- mean(knn_preds != test_labels)
}
knn_errors
best_k <- which.min(knn_errors)
cat("Best K:", best_k, "with Error:", knn_errors[best_k], "\n")
```

```{r plot-knn-errors}
plot(1:20, knn_errors, type = "b", xlab = "K", ylab = "Test Error Rate",
     main = "KNN Test Error by K")
```

## 9. Summary of Model Performance

```{r summary}
model_names <- c("LDA", "QDA", "Logistic Regression", "Naive Bayes", paste("KNN (k =", best_k, ")"))
error_rates <- c(lda_error, qda_error, log_reg_error, nb_error, knn_errors[best_k])
results <- data.frame(Model = model_names, Test_Error = error_rates)
print(results)
```
